shared_elements: standing human figure in strict profile
figure holding a long vertical staff/spear shaft with both hands
long garment with incised parallel drapery folds
low relief frieze of processional figures
justification: Both depict a bearded human figure in strict profile, wearing distinctive headgear and grasping a tall vertical spear/staff shaft with the hands stacked one above the other, rendered in shallow relief with fine incised parallel folds and repeated processional figures within a framed register — a very specific and conventional shared scheme. The main difference in content is that A includes a large two-humped animal led in procession as the focus, while B shows only closely spaced attendant figures with a quiver/bow at the shoulder and no animal.
